run_alpha_zero: run the full AlphaZero multi-process training loop with actors, evaluators, and a learner on a two-player sequential game
create_config_alpha_zero: create a Config dataclass instance specifying game, model architecture, and training hyperparameters for AlphaZero
build_mcts_bot: build an MCTS bot with configurable UCT constant, max simulations, and Dirichlet noise for AlphaZero gameplay
play_game_trajectory: play a single game between two MCTS bots and return the full trajectory of states, actions, and returns
train_replay_buffer: train the neural network by sampling batches from a replay buffer and saving checkpoints with policy and value losses
